title: Forecasting Sectoral Electricity Consumption in the Selected European Countries: Machine Learning versus Deep Learning Models

detail.title: Forecasting Sectoral Electricity Consumption in the Selected European Countries: Machine Learning versus Deep Learning Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animal subjects, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: Forecasting sectoral electricity consumption (SEC) is essential for energy system planning, decarbonization strategies, and monitoring progress toward climate and energy policy objectives in Europe. This study develops a comprehensive comparative framework using 266 annual sector–country time series for 19 selected European countries covering the period 1995–2023. Five forecasting approaches—Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and a hybrid CNN–BiLSTM–AR model (a convolutional and bidirectional LSTM architecture with an autoregressive component)—are systematically evaluated across 14 economic sectors. The results indicate that forecasting performance varies across models and sectors. The Random Forest model achieves the lowest forecasting errors in the majority of sector–country cases, particularly in sectors characterised by heterogeneous and volatile demand patterns. In contrast, deep-learning models perform competitively in energy-intensive sectors. ARIMA remains effective in selected sectors with relatively stable consumption dynamics, including iron and steel and transport equipment. Overall, Random Forest delivers the highest forecasting accuracy (MAPE = 8.31%), followed by ARIMA (MAPE = 9.84%), whereas SVM and LSTM exhibit higher average errors. Diebold–Mariano tests confirm that Random Forest, LSTM, and SVM outperform ARIMA in most combinations. The findings demonstrate that nonlinear and ensemble-based methods, particularly Random Forest, provide an accurate and robust approach for long-term sectoral electricity demand forecasting, thereby supporting renewable energy integration and decarbonization strategies in European countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个综合比较框架，使用1995-2023年19个欧洲国家的266个年度部门-国家时间序列，评估了五种预测方法（ARIMA、SVM、RF、LSTM和混合CNN-BiLSTM-AR模型）在14个经济部门的预测性能。结果显示随机森林模型在大多数部门-国家案例中表现最佳，特别是在需求模式异质且波动大的部门。
AI.research_question: 哪种预测方法（ARIMA、SVM、RF、LSTM和混合CNN-BiLSTM-AR）在欧洲部门电力消费预测中表现最优？预测性能如何随不同经济部门变化？
AI.motivation: 部门电力消费预测对能源系统规划、脱碳战略以及监测欧洲气候和能源政策目标的进展至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对不同预测方法在多个部门和国家的系统性比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间序列预测理论、机器学习（支持向量机、随机森林）和深度学习（LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM-AR）方法，构建了部门电力消费预测的比较分析框架。
AI.method: 使用1995-2023年19个欧洲国家的266个年度部门-国家时间序列，系统评估五种预测方法（ARIMA、SVM、RF、LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM-AR）在14个经济部门的性能，采用MAPE等指标和Diebold-Mariano检验。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型在大多数部门-国家案例中表现最佳（MAPE=8.31%），特别是在需求模式异质且波动大的部门；深度学习模型在能源密集型部门表现有竞争力；ARIMA在消费动态相对稳定的部门（如钢铁和运输设备）仍有效；SVM和LSTM平均误差较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了部门电力消费预测方法的综合比较框架，揭示了不同预测方法在不同部门特征下的性能差异，为时间序列预测理论在能源领域的应用提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲国家部门电力消费预测提供了最优方法选择指导（推荐随机森林），支持可再生能源整合和脱碳战略，有助于能源系统规划和政策制定。

title: Trading Returns for Privacy: Experimental Evidence from Financial Data Leaks

detail.title: Trading Returns for Privacy: Experimental Evidence from Financial Data Leaks
detail.abstract: This paper provides benchmark experimental evidence on how individuals trade off financial performance against the risk of disclosing their own financial information when privacy risks are explicit, and outcomes are immediate. In a laboratory investment task with repeated decisions, participants choose between two risky options that differ in expected return and in an explicitly stated probability that choosing one option triggers a pseudonymous disclosure of a limited subset of their pre-elicited financial information to other participants. Participants respond systematically to both return spreads and leak probabilities, but choices are substantially more elastic to financial incentives than to changes in leak risk. In dynamic analyses, experiencing an own leak has modest and short-lived effects, whereas higher leakage among other participants is followed by a lower propensity to select the privacy-risky option. Standard measures of risk and loss aversion and most economic characteristics explain little of the heterogeneity in choices, while context-relevant privacy attitudes are associated with more privacy-protective behavior. Overall, in this transparent-probability benchmark environment, monetary incentives dominate leak risk on average, while social information about others' leaks meaningfully shapes behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验室投资任务，考察了人们在财务激励与隐私泄露风险之间的权衡。研究发现，参与者对财务激励的反应远比对隐私泄露风险的反应更敏感，且他人的泄露经历会影响个体的隐私保护行为。
AI.research_question: 当隐私风险明确且结果即时时，个体如何在财务绩效与自身财务信息泄露风险之间进行权衡？
AI.motivation: 理解在隐私风险明确且结果即时的情况下，个体如何权衡财务激励与隐私保护，这对于设计隐私保护政策和理解隐私决策行为具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、隐私经济学、风险决策理论，结合财务激励与隐私风险的权衡框架。
AI.method: 实验室投资任务实验，参与者需要在两个风险选项之间重复选择：一个选项有更高的预期回报但有一定概率触发财务信息泄露（匿名披露给其他参与者）。
AI.findings: 1. 参与者对财务激励的反应比对隐私泄露风险的反应更敏感；2. 自身经历泄露只有短暂轻微影响；3. 他人泄露经历会降低选择隐私风险选项的倾向；4. 标准风险厌恶测量和大多数经济特征对选择异质性解释有限；5. 与情境相关的隐私态度与隐私保护行为相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了在透明概率基准环境下财务激励与隐私风险权衡的实证证据；2. 揭示了社会信息在隐私决策中的重要作用；3. 挑战了传统风险厌恶测量在解释隐私决策中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为隐私政策设计提供实证依据；2. 提示在隐私保护中需要考虑社会影响；3. 表明财务激励在隐私决策中可能比隐私风险更有效。

title: Structuring Investment Vehicles for Biotech and Healthcare Real Estate in India
affiliations: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar National Law University, Sonepat

detail.title: Structuring Investment Vehicles for Biotech and Healthcare Real Estate in India
detail.abstract: This research examines the regulatory and legal impediments obstructing institutional investment in India's biotech and healthcare real estate sector, a critical domain facing a paradox of acute infrastructure deficits amidst restrictive capital frameworks. With India's healthcare expenditure lagging at 1.9% of GDP and a projected requirement of three million additional beds by 2047, the study analyses why traditional financing mechanisms fail to bridge this gap. Employing a doctrinal legal methodology, the paper scrutinises the structural limitations within the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Real Estate Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014, and the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), 1999. It argues that the current statutory definition of "real estate assets" and stringent asset concentration norms effectively exclude specialised healthcare infrastructure, such as hospitals and biotech parks, from accessing public capital markets. Drawing upon comparative legal analyses of mature healthcare REIT jurisdictions, including Singapore, Australia, and the United States, the research identifies best practices regarding asset valuation, revenue recognition, and risk management. The study concludes by proposing a comprehensive legal reform framework, advocating for the creation of a specialised "Healthcare REIT" category with modified distribution and concentration norms (up to 40% per asset). Furthermore, it recommends the liberalisation of FDI policies specific to healthcare infrastructure and the introduction of hybrid PPP-REIT structures to harmonise investor rights with public health imperatives, thereby facilitating efficient capital deployment in this capital intensive sector.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度生物技术和医疗房地产领域机构投资的法律障碍，指出当前REIT法规和外汇管理法限制了专业医疗基础设施获得公共资本市场融资，并提出了建立专门"医疗REIT"类别和改革FDI政策的建议。
AI.research_question: 印度生物技术和医疗房地产领域的监管和法律障碍如何阻碍机构投资？如何通过法律改革促进该领域的资本流动？
AI.motivation: 印度医疗支出仅占GDP的1.9%，到2047年需要增加300万张病床，但当前融资机制无法满足这一巨大基础设施缺口，存在限制性资本框架与基础设施严重不足的悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与监管框架分析理论、比较法律分析理论、房地产投资信托(REIT)理论、机构投资理论、公私合作(PPP)理论。
AI.method: 采用教义法律研究方法，分析印度证券交易委员会(REIT)法规2014和外汇管理法1999的结构性限制，并进行新加坡、澳大利亚和美国等成熟医疗REIT司法管辖区的比较法律分析。
AI.findings: 当前法规中"房地产资产"的法定定义和严格的资产集中度规范实际上将医院和生物技术园区等专业医疗基础设施排除在公共资本市场之外，阻碍了机构投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了医疗基础设施融资的法律障碍理论框架，发展了专门医疗REIT类别的理论模型，为新兴市场医疗房地产投资提供了比较法律分析的理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出建立专门"医疗REIT"类别（资产集中度可达40%）、医疗基础设施FDI政策自由化、引入混合PPP-REIT结构等具体法律改革建议，促进资本高效配置。

title: College Admission Policies and Pre-College Human Capital Investment: Evidence from China
affiliations: China National Academy of Educational Sciences, Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management and Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management

detail.title: College Admission Policies and Pre-College Human Capital Investment: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: We develop a model of pre-college human capital investment, wherein students with heterogeneous ability levels compete under an exam-centric college admission system. Human capital investment is incentivized through two channels: a productive channel and a competitive channel-the latter being the source of overinvestment and inefficiency. We solve for a competitive equilibrium where students take colleges' admission cutoff scores as given. Using microdata from China's college admissions, we estimate that the current system induces an excess effort of two additional hours of daily study and an efficiency loss equivalent to 1.5% of post-college wage levels, with the competitive channel dominating the productive channel at the margin. Policies aimed at narrowing the college quality gap or expanding enrollment quotas at high-quality colleges can mitigate such excess effort and efficiency loss.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国高考制度下学生过度投资人力资本的问题，发现竞争性激励导致学生每天额外学习2小时，造成相当于毕业后工资水平1.5%的效率损失，可通过缩小高校质量差距或扩大优质高校招生名额来缓解。
AI.research_question: 在考试中心的大学录取制度下，异质能力学生的人力资本投资如何受到激励？竞争性渠道如何导致过度投资和效率损失？
AI.motivation: 中国高考制度下学生面临巨大学习压力，存在明显的"过度学习"现象，需要理解这种竞争性教育投资的经济效率影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本投资模型，区分生产性渠道（提升实际能力）和竞争性渠道（相对排名竞争），后者导致社会效率损失。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析学生异质能力下的竞争均衡，利用中国大学录取微观数据进行实证估计。
AI.findings: 当前制度导致学生每天额外学习2小时，效率损失相当于毕业后工资水平的1.5%，边际上竞争性渠道主导生产性渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论区分了人力资本投资的生产性和竞争性激励渠道，为理解考试中心录取制度的效率影响提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出缩小高校质量差距和扩大优质高校招生名额的政策建议，可有效减少过度努力和效率损失。

title: The Effects of Noise-Related Airport Charges: Greenwashing or Real Incentives for Airlines?
affiliations: University of Bologna and University of Barcelona

detail.title: The Effects of Noise-Related Airport Charges: Greenwashing or Real Incentives for Airlines?
detail.abstract: Aviation noise pollution, affecting one in five Europeans and tied to severe health risks, demands robust strategies to safeguard public well-being. This paper investigates whether noise-related airport charges in the European Economic Area (2006-2024) encourage airlines to use quieter aircraft, addressing a critical gap in the literature through a brand-new dataset of 84 airports. Employing a staggered Difference-inDifferences approach with the Callaway-Sant'Anna (2021) robust estimator, the study analyses airline responses to noise charge schemes at 16 airports in 9 different countries. Findings show that noise-related charges, as currently implemented, do not significantly influence airline behavior, with no detectable changes in the use of quieter, newgeneration or winglets-equipped aircraft, with ATTs statistically indistinguishable from zero. Ineffective policy design, characterized by minimal financial incentives and inadequate differentiation between aircraft types, helps to explain these null findings. A political economy lens suggests these charges may function more as instrument of greenwashing-designed to appease community concerns while minimizing disruption to airline interests-than as genuine environmental regulation. This research highlights the urgent need for stronger, better-calibrated noise charge frameworks to reduce aviation's acoustic footprint, offering actionable insights for policymakers to enhance environmental regulation and protect local communities' public health.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析欧洲经济区84个机场2006-2024年的数据发现，现行的噪音相关机场收费政策未能有效激励航空公司使用更安静的飞机，政策设计存在缺陷，可能更多是"绿色洗白"工具而非真正的环境监管。
AI.research_question: 欧洲经济区的噪音相关机场收费是否能够有效激励航空公司使用更安静的飞机？
AI.motivation: 航空噪音污染影响欧洲五分之一人口并带来严重健康风险，需要有效策略保护公共健康。现有文献对噪音收费政策效果的研究存在空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学（环境规制理论）、行为经济学（激励理论）、政治经济学（绿色洗白理论）
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered Difference-in-Differences），使用Callaway-Sant'Anna（2021）稳健估计器，分析9个国家16个机场的噪音收费方案对航空公司行为的影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现噪音相关收费政策在现行实施方式下对航空公司行为没有显著影响，没有检测到航空公司增加使用更安静的新一代飞机或翼梢小翼飞机的变化，平均处理效应统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）填补了噪音收费政策效果实证研究的空白；2）从政治经济学视角揭示了环境政策可能作为"绿色洗白"工具而非有效监管；3）为环境规制理论提供了航空噪音政策的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供改进噪音收费框架的具体建议；2）揭示现行政策设计缺陷（激励不足、飞机类型区分不够）；3）强调需要更强有力的校准政策来减少航空噪音影响；4）为保护当地社区公共健康提供行动指南。

title: The Impact of Asset-light Strategies and Ownership Structures on Intangibles.

detail.title: The Impact of Asset-light Strategies and Ownership Structures on Intangibles.
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of asset-light strategies on the ratio of goodwill and other intangibles to total assets, including the moderating effect of ownership type. The basis of this analysis is a sample of 64 international hospitality firms (814 firm-year observations) from 2011 to 2023. Using Tobit models, results find that asset-light operating strategies increase the proportion of goodwill and intangible assets in hospitality firms. Notably, this relationship significantly depends on the type of primary owner. Institutional ownership, for example, weakens the effect of asset-lightness on the goodwill-to-total-assets ratio. This study offers guidance as to the balance sheet implications of asset-light and fee-oriented strategies across ownership types. Analysts and managers can use these findings to determine how different ownership types may treat asset-light strategies and intangible assets.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了资产轻量化战略对酒店企业商誉和无形资产占总资产比例的影响，并考察了所有权类型的调节作用。基于2011-2023年64家国际酒店企业的814个企业年度观测数据，研究发现资产轻量化战略会增加商誉和无形资产比例，但这一关系受到所有权类型的显著调节，机构所有权会削弱资产轻量化对商誉比例的影响。
AI.research_question: 资产轻量化战略如何影响酒店企业的商誉和无形资产占总资产的比例？所有权类型如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 随着酒店行业越来越多地采用资产轻量化和费用导向型战略，这些战略对资产负债表结构（特别是商誉和无形资产比例）的影响尚不明确。同时，不同所有权类型的企业可能对这些战略的实施和会计处理存在差异，需要实证研究来指导管理者和分析师。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司战略与会计价值理论、所有权结构理论、无形资产估值理论，探讨资产轻量化战略如何通过并购、品牌授权等途径影响商誉和无形资产，以及不同所有权类型如何调节这一过程。
AI.method: 使用Tobit回归模型分析2011-2023年64家国际酒店企业的814个企业年度观测数据，考察资产轻量化战略对商誉和无形资产比例的影响，并检验所有权类型的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. 资产轻量化运营战略显著增加了酒店企业商誉和无形资产占总资产的比例；2. 这种关系显著依赖于主要所有者类型；3. 机构所有权会削弱资产轻量化对商誉占总资产比例的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了资产轻量化战略的会计后果研究；2. 揭示了所有权类型在战略实施与会计结果之间的调节作用；3. 丰富了酒店行业无形资产估值理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者和分析师提供了关于不同所有权类型下资产轻量化战略资产负债表影响的指导；2. 帮助决策者理解不同所有权结构如何影响资产轻量化战略的实施和无形资产处理；3. 为投资者评估酒店企业价值提供了参考框架。

title: Virtual Permanent Establishment: Indian High Court Rejects Clamour to Expand Tax Treaty Contours

detail.title: Virtual Permanent Establishment: Indian High Court Rejects Clamour to Expand Tax Treaty Contours
detail.abstract: Increasing digital presence of offshore businesses and the inability of traditional tax rules has been pushing creative interpretation of the legal regime with Indian courts continuously being required to opine upon their legitimacy and application. A recent decision of the Delhi High Court has addressed the argument of the Indian tax authorities that digitally present Non-Resident business entities would become taxable in Indian in view of ‘virtual permanent establishment’. Emphatically rejecting these contentions, the High Court has declared that the language of the Indian bilateral tax treaties does not accommodate such extension of well understood contours of permanent establishment.

AI.tldr: 印度德里高等法院最近裁决，拒绝印度税务机关关于"虚拟常设机构"的论点，认为印度双边税收协定不支持将传统常设机构概念扩展到数字存在。
AI.research_question: 印度双边税收协定是否允许将传统常设机构概念扩展到数字存在，从而对数字存在的非居民企业征税？
AI.motivation: 离岸企业数字存在不断增加，传统税收规则无法有效应对，导致对法律制度的创造性解释，印度法院需要持续裁决其合法性和适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 常设机构概念、双边税收协定解释、数字税收管辖权、虚拟常设机构理论。
AI.method: 法律案例分析，特别是德里高等法院的判决分析，以及对印度双边税收协定条款的解释。
AI.findings: 德里高等法院明确拒绝了印度税务机关的论点，宣布印度双边税收协定的语言不支持将传统常设机构概念扩展到虚拟常设机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了印度双边税收协定中常设机构概念的界限，为数字税收管辖权提供了法律解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非居民数字企业提供了法律确定性，限制了税务机关的过度扩张解释，为类似案件提供了判例参考。

title: Patents & Access to Health-Technologies in Everyday Healthcare Contexts for Rare Diseases: Implications and Limitations of the Right to Health at the National Level?

detail.abstract:
Patent rights enable rightsholders to exclude others from using a technology for typically 20 years. The exclusionary nature of patents mean they can be used to incentivize certain technological developments, including health-technologies. On the other hand, this exclusionary role also means that patents can be used in ways that can create barriers for access to technologies. For patents over health-related technologies, such as medicines, vaccines and medical devices, this can have significant health implications for patients. Thus, it is sometimes argued that the right to health could be used to mobilize greater access to patented health-technologies. 

This chapter analyses the role of the right to health, focusing on Article 12(1) International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights 1966, as an avenue to be used within national States to obtain greater access to patented health-technologies. Against the backdrop of increasing costs of medicines globally, within high-income and low- and middle-income States, this chapter focuses on the role of the right to health in everyday healthcare contexts. It examines whether and to what extent, the right to health can be leveraged at the national level within States – by individual patients and/or their families, and by States - to offer effective avenues to address access issues posed by certain uses of IPRs over health-technologies. It also analyses various limitations of the right to health in such contexts.

The chapter argues that for the right to health to offer an effective avenue in national contexts to appropriately balance patients’ interests with intellectual property rightsholders’ interests, States must show greater willingness to engage with the right to health in a proactive manner, including using this right to support targeted policy and legislative reform. A key element of this is the need for greater State recognition and engagement with the collective dimension of the right to health.  Moreover, it argues- that the more States which adopt such approaches, the greater likelihood that the right to health can offer effective avenues to address these issues.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨健康权如何作为在国家层面获取专利健康技术更大可及性的途径，分析健康权在平衡患者利益与知识产权持有人利益方面的作用，并指出国家需要更积极地运用健康权来支持政策立法改革。
AI.research_question: 健康权（特别是《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约》第12条第1款）能否以及如何在国家层面被利用，为患者及其家庭以及国家提供有效途径，解决知识产权对健康技术可及性造成的障碍？
AI.motivation: 专利的排他性虽然能激励健康技术发展，但也可能阻碍患者获取关键医疗技术。随着全球药品成本不断上涨，无论是高收入国家还是中低收入国家都面临健康技术可及性问题。健康权作为一项基本人权，可能为解决这一矛盾提供法律途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际人权法框架，特别是《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约》第12条第1款规定的健康权；知识产权法理论；健康权与知识产权保护的平衡理论；国家义务理论。
AI.method: 法律分析方法和规范性分析方法，分析国际人权法框架下的健康权规定，探讨其在国家层面的适用性和局限性，考察患者、家庭和国家如何利用健康权解决专利健康技术的可及性问题。
AI.findings: 健康权确实可以在国家层面为获取专利健康技术提供有效途径，但需要国家更积极地运用这一权利。关键在于国家需要认识到健康权的集体维度，并通过有针对性的政策和立法改革来支持健康权的实现。越多国家采取这种积极态度，健康权就越能有效解决专利健康技术的可及性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了健康权与知识产权保护之间关系的理论理解；2. 提出了健康权集体维度的重要性；3. 构建了健康权在国家层面平衡患者利益与知识产权持有人利益的理论框架；4. 为国际人权法在国内法中的适用提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为患者及其家庭提供了利用健康权争取医疗技术可及性的法律途径；2. 为国家制定平衡知识产权保护与公共健康需求的政策提供了指导；3. 指出了国家需要进行的政策和立法改革方向；4. 为国际社会应对全球药品成本上涨问题提供了人权法视角的解决方案。

title: How Farm Advisory Roles Evolve: A Ten-Year Comparison of Advice for Diffuse Water Pollution Mitigation in England

detail.title: How Farm Advisory Roles Evolve: A Ten-Year Comparison of Advice for Diffuse Water Pollution Mitigation in England
detail.abstract: Reducing diffuse water pollution from agriculture (DWPA) is an increasingly important challenge for water quality management and associated environmental outcomes. Farm advisory services act as key knowledge brokers, guiding the selection and implementation of effective mitigation measures. Despite the recognised importance of advisory services, there remains a paucity of research examining how advice varies across space and time. This paper applies a mixed-methods approach to assess spatial and temporal variation in DWPA advice provision across England. Using semi-structured interviews with farm advisors, a repeated cross-sectional design compares data collected 10 years apart. Statistical proximity scaling was used to map organisational advisory niches, supported by qualitative insights. The results show that DWPA advice varies markedly between organisations and across regions, reflecting distinct advisory niches shaped by localised needs. Over time, the findings indicate increasing specialisation in advice provision. By revealing how advisory roles, emphases and overlaps change across space and time, the results provide evidence to support more coherent and targeted advisory provision as agriculture transitions towards environmentally sustainable production systems. The nichemapping approach developed here offers a transferable framework for evaluating advisory systems in other geographical and regulatory contexts, supporting comparative assessment and adaptive governance beyond the English case.

AI.research_question: 英格兰农业面源污染(DWPA)咨询服务在空间和时间维度上如何变化？
AI.motivation: 农业面源污染治理日益重要，农场咨询服务作为关键知识中介，指导有效减排措施的选择和实施。尽管咨询服务的重要性得到认可，但关于其时空变化的研究仍然匮乏。

AI.method: 混合方法：半结构化访谈农场顾问，采用10年间隔的重复横断面设计，统计邻近度标度用于绘制组织咨询生态位图，辅以定性分析

3. 咨询角色、重点和重叠部分在时空维度上发生变化

title: Ivory Tower or Transdisciplinarity? Measuring the Preferences of Scientists at Public Research Institutes Regarding Academic Engagement

detail.title: Ivory Tower or Transdisciplinarity? Measuring the Preferences of Scientists at Public Research Institutes Regarding Academic Engagement
detail.abstract: Increasingly complex societal challenges require more transdisciplinary collaboration between researchers and practitioners. Previous studies measured and categorised motivations driving researchers to choose projects involving practitioners and provided empirical evidence for the existence of the ‘puzzle-ribbon-gold’ typology. However, neither well-known decision factors such as research funding and societal impact nor preferences on the terms of collaboration have yet been integrated in any researcher typology. Here, we use a discrete choice experiment to elicit the preferences of 862 researchers employed at German public research institutes (PRIs) over research project alternatives that vary in six attributes (funding volume, academic success, societal impact, knowledge transfer, knowledge co-production, and practitioner type), of which most had three levels (low, medium, high). We determine that scientists in our sample, on average, attach positive value to engaging with practitioners. However, their preferences are not homogeneous. We find that PRI researchers can be categorized in three latent classes: ‘changemakers’, who prioritise creating societal impact via public-sector knowledge co-production; ‘fundraisers’, who focus on acquiring financial resources by transferring knowledge to the private sector; and ‘scholars’, who concentrate on academic success and avoid practitioners. Thus, we derive inductively a researcher typology that accounts for so far neglected but demonstrably decision-relevant aspects, that is impact, funding, collaboration form, and partner type. Interestingly, various observable individual and contextual variables do not offer much additional information in terms of explaining preference heterogeneity. We conclude by discussing policy instruments to foster academic engagement as well as future research directions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过离散选择实验分析德国公共研究机构研究人员的偏好，发现可将研究人员分为三类：注重社会影响的"变革者"、关注资金获取的"筹款者"和专注学术成功的"学者"。
AI.research_question: 研究人员在跨学科合作项目中的偏好如何？哪些因素（如资金、社会影响、合作形式等）影响他们的选择？能否基于这些偏好建立新的研究人员分类体系？
AI.motivation: 日益复杂的社会挑战需要研究人员与实践者进行更多跨学科合作。现有研究虽然提出了"puzzle-ribbon-gold"分类法，但尚未整合资金、社会影响等关键决策因素以及合作条件偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择理论和研究人员动机分类理论，特别是"puzzle-ribbon-gold"分类法（puzzle：学术好奇心；ribbon：职业认可；gold：资金/资源）。
AI.method: 采用离散选择实验方法，对德国公共研究机构的862名研究人员进行调查。实验设计了六个属性（资金规模、学术成功、社会影响、知识转移、知识共同生产、实践者类型），大多数属性有三个水平（低、中、高）。
AI.findings: 1. 研究人员总体上对与实践者合作持积极态度；2. 偏好存在异质性，可分为三类：变革者（优先通过公共部门知识共同生产创造社会影响）、筹款者（通过向私营部门转移知识获取资金）、学者（专注学术成功并避免与实践者合作）；3. 个体和情境变量对解释偏好异质性贡献有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了新的研究人员分类体系，整合了先前被忽视但决策相关的因素（影响、资金、合作形式、合作伙伴类型）；2. 扩展了现有的"puzzle-ribbon-gold"分类法；3. 为理解研究人员参与跨学科合作的动机提供了更全面的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计促进学术参与的工具提供依据；2. 帮助研究机构更好地匹配研究人员偏好与合作机会；3. 为跨学科合作项目的设计和管理提供指导；4. 指出了未来研究方向。

detail.abstract: The Elevator Advertising Market has emerged as a rapidly expanding segment of the out-of-home advertising ecosystem. Leveraging the captive nature of elevator audiences in residential, commercial, and mixed-use buildings, this market provides high engagement rates and measurable return on investment for advertisers. This paper examines market structure, technological innovations, consumer engagement, regional dynamics, revenue models, regulatory frameworks, and post-COVID trends. It also identifies opportunities, challenges, and future growth prospects. Through a synthesis of market data, case studies, and industry reports, this research provides a comprehensive understanding of the Elevator Advertising Market's current landscape and its trajectory toward 2035.

title:
The Cognitive Absorption Limit: Why Strategic Agility Destroys Implementation Fidelity

A Theory of Organizational Cognitive Congestion

detail.title:
The Cognitive Absorption Limit: Why Strategic Agility Destroys Implementation Fidelity

A Theory of Organizational Cognitive Congestion
detail.abstract: Dynamic capabilities theory and strategic agility research advocate continuous organizational adaptation without establishing absorptive capacity boundaries. This paper advances a confrontational claim: organizational strategy change frequency is bounded primarily by cognitive absorption limits rather than environmental dynamism. The theory demonstrates that frequent strategy change generates structural cognitive overload at the organizational level, degrading implementation fidelity through three mechanisms-sensemaking truncation, schema construction interruption, and execution pattern destabilization. Beyond a critical change-frequency threshold, additional strategic agility systematically reduces implementation fidelity regardless of leadership quality or environmental turbulence. The framework challenges foundational assumptions in strategy literature by demonstrating that dynamic capabilities theory implicitly assumes infinite absorptive capacity, strategic agility research conflates responsiveness with reversibility, and alignment research ignores time as causal variable. Six falsifiable propositions specify threshold effects, boundary conditions identify where theory does not apply, and empirical pathways enable falsification. The analysis reveals HR temporal lag as amplification mechanism rather than independent phenomenon, with policy implications demanding immediate cessation of biannual strategy revision practices.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了动态能力理论和战略敏捷性研究的核心假设，提出组织战略变革频率主要受认知吸收能力限制而非环境动态性影响。研究发现频繁战略变革会导致结构性认知超载，通过三种机制降低实施保真度，并存在临界阈值效应。
AI.research_question: 组织战略变革频率的主要限制因素是什么？频繁战略变革如何影响实施保真度？是否存在战略变革频率的临界阈值？
AI.motivation: 现有动态能力理论和战略敏捷性研究倡导持续组织适应，但忽视了认知吸收能力的边界限制。该论文旨在挑战这些理论的基本假设，揭示频繁战略变革的实际负面后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论、战略敏捷性研究、认知吸收理论、组织学习理论、结构认知超载理论
AI.method: 理论构建与命题发展方法，包括理论分析、概念框架构建、六个可证伪命题的提出、边界条件识别和实证路径设计
AI.findings: 1. 组织战略变革频率主要受认知吸收能力限制而非环境动态性影响；2. 频繁战略变革通过三种机制降低实施保真度：意义建构截断、图式构建中断、执行模式失稳；3. 存在临界变革频率阈值，超过该阈值后战略敏捷性会系统性降低实施保真度；4. 人力资源时间滞后是放大机制而非独立现象
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战动态能力理论隐含的无限吸收能力假设；2. 揭示战略敏捷性研究混淆响应性与可逆性的问题；3. 指出对齐研究忽视时间作为因果变量；4. 提出认知吸收能力作为战略变革的主要边界条件
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议立即停止半年一次的战略修订实践；2. 为组织制定战略变革节奏提供理论依据；3. 帮助管理者识别战略变革的临界阈值；4. 强调实施保真度而非单纯变革频率的重要性

title: Leverage, Financial Performance of PN17 Companies and Macroeconomic in Malaysia: A Panel Data Analysis

detail.title: Leverage, Financial Performance of PN17 Companies and Macroeconomic in Malaysia: A Panel Data Analysis

declarations.funderStatement: The author declared no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This study looks into the factors that influence capital structure in companies that fall under Bursa Malaysia's Practice Note 17 (PN17). Severe financial distress is indicated by the PN17 status, which can be linked with an unstable capital structure and an over-reliance on external financing. Among these problematic Malaysian companies, the study aimed to determine the firm-specific financial characteristics that have a major impact on the Debtto-Equity (DE) and Assets-to-Equity (AE) Ratio, a key indicator of financial leverage and risk. The study used panel data regression analysis to investigate the relationship between the DE Ratio (the dependent variable) and profitability such as PTROA and ROE and macroeconomic factor, GDP and IR. Secondary data was gathered from the annual reports of a panel of PN17 companies over a ten-year latest period (2015-2024). The PN17 list was taken from BUSMA Malaysia website at 14 October 2025 and there are 16 company been selected as sample.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨马来西亚PN17公司资本结构的影响因素，发现盈利能力（PTROA、ROE）和宏观经济因素（GDP、利率）对负债权益比有显著影响，PN17公司过度依赖外部融资且资本结构不稳定。
AI.research_question: 哪些公司特定财务特征和宏观经济因素对马来西亚PN17公司的负债权益比和资产权益比（衡量财务杠杆和风险的关键指标）有显著影响？
AI.motivation: PN17状态表明公司面临严重财务困境，通常伴随着不稳定的资本结构和过度依赖外部融资。了解这些困境公司的资本结构决定因素对于风险管理、政策制定和公司治理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本结构理论（如权衡理论、优序融资理论），结合财务困境公司的特殊性，探讨公司特定因素（盈利能力）和宏观经济因素对资本结构的影响。
AI.method: 采用面板数据回归分析，以负债权益比为因变量，自变量包括公司盈利能力指标（PTROA、ROE）和宏观经济因素（GDP、利率）。数据来源于16家PN17公司2015-2024年的年度报告。
AI.findings: 研究发现盈利能力指标（PTROA、ROE）和宏观经济因素（GDP、利率）对PN17公司的负债权益比有显著影响。PN17公司普遍存在资本结构不稳定和过度依赖外部融资的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了资本结构理论在财务困境公司中的应用，为理解特殊监管状态下的公司融资行为提供了理论视角，丰富了新兴市场财务困境公司的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PN17公司管理者提供资本结构优化建议，为投资者评估财务风险提供参考，为监管机构制定相关政策提供实证依据，有助于改善马来西亚困境公司的治理和融资决策。

detail.title: The Special Role of "Four-Three Plan" in The History of New China's Reform and Opening up
detail.abstract: The "Four-Three Plan" has long been recognized as a pivotal turning point in the evolution of New China's economic development and political strategy. This paper reviews both Chinese and Western literature, drawing on influential Chinese studies and significant Western analyses, to reassess the origins, content, implementation, and long-term impact of the plan. The study employs a comprehensive factor analysis framework that examines internal dynamics(politi cal directives, institutional inertia, and socioeconomic challenges) and external influences (Soviet aid, global economic trends, and emerging reform imperatives). Special attention is given to the plan's multifaceted contributions: its role in stimulating early industrial restructuring, providing a testing ground for marketoriented policies, and laying the groundwork for subsequent "Reform and Opening Up" initiatives. Key statistical data are introduced to illustrate improvements in industrial output, GDP growth rates, and trade expansion attributable to early policy experiments under the plan. While the plan's transformative impact is evident, its limitations including over-ambitious targets and structural inefficiencies are critically discussed. Moreover, the paper explores the intricate relationship between the "Four-Three Plan" ， earlier Soviet Aid initiatives, and the later, more market-oriented reforms. Finally, the study highlights recent quantitative analyses that have employed econometric and inputoutput models to re-evaluate the plan's legacy, offering new insights into its 1 The paper is presented at the 82nd MPSA Annual Conference in Chicago in April 2025 historical significance. This multifaceted review ultimately argues that the "Four-Three Plan" represents both a product of its historical moment and a catalyst for China's later success in integrating into the global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了新中国经济发展和政治战略的关键转折点——"四三计划"，通过综合分析框架探讨其起源、内容、实施和长期影响，认为该计划既是历史时期的产物，也是中国后来成功融入全球经济的催化剂。
AI.research_question: "四三计划"的起源、内容、实施和长期影响是什么？它如何影响中国早期的工业重组、市场导向政策试验，并为后来的改革开放奠定基础？
AI.motivation: "四三计划"被认为是新中国经济发展和政治战略演变的关键转折点，但现有研究对其全面评估不足。本文旨在通过综合中西方文献，重新评估该计划的历史意义和长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用综合因素分析框架，考察内部动态（政治指令、制度惯性、社会经济挑战）和外部影响（苏联援助、全球经济趋势、改革压力）。特别关注计划的多方面贡献及其与苏联援助项目和后来市场导向改革的关系。
AI.method: 文献综述法，结合中西方重要研究；引入关键统计数据（工业产出、GDP增长率、贸易扩张）；运用计量经济学和投入产出模型进行定量分析。
AI.findings: "四三计划"在刺激早期工业重组、提供市场导向政策试验场、为改革开放奠定基础方面发挥了重要作用。统计数据显示工业产出、GDP增长率和贸易扩张均有改善。但计划也存在目标过高和结构效率低下等局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了"四三计划"的综合评估框架；2）阐明了该计划作为历史产物和改革催化剂的双重角色；3）揭示了早期计划与后来市场改革之间的复杂关系；4）运用现代计量方法重新评估历史经济政策的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为理解中国经济发展路径提供历史视角；2）为政策制定者提供早期经济计划的经验教训；3）展示了渐进式改革与市场导向政策试验的重要性；4）为评估类似经济转型计划提供分析框架。

detail.title: A Comparative Study of "On The Ten Major Relationships" and the "Eight-Character Policy"
detail.abstract: This paper undertakes a comparative analysis of two seminal policy frameworks in modern Chinese economic history, the "On the Ten Major Relationships" and the "Eight-Character Policy". Drawing on a comprehensive literature review that synthesizes key Chinese studies and influential Western works, the study examines the origins, content, implementation processes, and impacts of these policies on China's economic development. The "Ten Major Relationships," introduced during the transitional period, rebalanced various economic sectors and social interests, while the "Eight-Character Policy" (expressed as adjustment, enrichment, consolidation, and improvement) guided the subsequent reforms twice. Through a multidimensional analysis, historical, methodological, and quantitative, the paper reveals the profound internal linkages between these two approaches and their role in steering China away from an early Soviet model toward a uniquely Chinese reform and opening-up strategy. Key statistical data and quantitative findings from econometric studies support the conclusion that these policies were instrumental in setting the stage for New China's modern economic transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文对新中国经济史上两大标志性政策框架——《论十大关系》和"八字方针"进行了比较分析，揭示了它们如何引导中国从早期苏联模式转向具有中国特色的改革开放道路。
AI.research_question: 《论十大关系》和"八字方针"这两大政策框架在起源、内容、实施过程和影响方面有何异同？它们如何共同引导中国从苏联模式转向中国特色改革开放道路？
AI.motivation: 理解新中国经济转型的关键政策框架，揭示中国如何从早期苏联模式转向独特的改革开放战略，填补对这两大标志性政策系统性比较研究的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策比较分析框架、经济转型理论、制度变迁理论、中国特色的社会主义经济理论
AI.method: 多维分析方法：历史分析、方法论分析、定量分析；综合文献综述（包括中国关键研究和西方有影响力著作）；统计数据和计量经济学研究支持
AI.findings: 1.《论十大关系》在过渡时期重新平衡了各经济部门和社会利益；2."八字方针"（调整、充实、巩固、提高）两次指导了后续改革；3.两大政策框架之间存在深刻的内在联系；4.这些政策在引导中国从苏联模式转向中国特色改革开放战略中发挥了关键作用
AI.theory_contributions: 1.建立了新中国经济政策比较分析的理论框架；2.揭示了政策连续性与变革性的辩证关系；3.深化了对中国特色经济转型路径的理论理解；4.为理解制度变迁中的路径依赖与创新提供了理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1.为当前经济政策制定提供历史经验借鉴；2.帮助理解中国改革开放的历史逻辑；3.为发展中国家经济转型提供中国经验参考；4.为政策评估和优化提供方法论指导

title: First-Mover Advantage in Sustainability: An Agent-based Model Perspective

detail.title: First-Mover Advantage in Sustainability: An Agent-based Model Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper utilizes an Agent-Based Model (ABM) to investigate the efficacy of an eco-tax policy in driving corporate green transition within a heterogeneous industry of Green and Brown firms. The model applies a dynamic financial penalty proportional to environmental impact, compelling Brown firms to reallocate capital toward green investment to mitigate their tax burden. Simulation results demonstrate that this mechanism is decisively effective: the eco-tax successfully forces all Brown firms to transition to Green status, achieving complete industry-wide environmental convergence by the simulation’s end. The analysis shows the tax acts as a powerful Pigouvian instrument, accelerating the green transformation and confirming that environmental policy can fundamentally align economic incentives with sustainability objectives. Furthermore, long-term trends reveal that while the tax ensures transition, firms that started Green maintain greater long-term profit stability than those forced to transition, underscoring the enduring competitive advantage of proactive sustainability.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用基于代理的模型(ABM)分析生态税政策在推动企业绿色转型中的效果，发现按环境影响的动态罚款能有效迫使所有棕色企业转型为绿色企业，实现行业完全绿色化，但主动绿色企业比被迫转型企业有更稳定的长期利润。
AI.research_question: 生态税政策如何有效推动异质性行业（绿色企业和棕色企业）的企业绿色转型？
AI.motivation: 研究生态税作为环境政策工具的有效性，探索如何通过经济激励推动企业绿色转型，实现可持续发展目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理的建模(ABM)、庇古税理论、企业绿色转型理论、环境经济学。
AI.method: 基于代理的模型(ABM)模拟，建立包含绿色和棕色企业的异质性行业模型，应用与环境影响成正比的动态财务罚款机制。
AI.findings: 1. 生态税能有效迫使所有棕色企业转型为绿色企业，实现行业完全绿色化；2. 生态税作为庇古税工具，能加速绿色转型；3. 主动绿色企业比被迫转型企业有更稳定的长期利润优势。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计有效的生态税政策提供依据；2. 帮助企业理解主动绿色转型的长期价值；3. 为行业绿色转型提供可操作的政策工具。

title: What Drives the Correlations between Human and Financial Capital Returns? An International Portfolio Choice Approach
affiliations: Washington and Lee University - Williams School of Commerce, Economics, and Politics and

detail.title: What Drives the Correlations between Human and Financial Capital Returns? An International Portfolio Choice Approach
detail.abstract: During the Great Moderation – a time from 1985 to 2020 characterized by broad economic stability, low inflation, and mild business cycles – human capital returns instead became riskier. Income volatility increased, workers were bearing more risk in labor markets, and globalization exposed human capital to risks from a more internationally integrated economy. But measuring human capital risk and returns presents distinct challenges. We estimate the correlation between human and financial capital returns implied by observable international portfolio holdings, financial returns data, and a portfolio choice model. Implied correlations vary across countries and time, and are related to education, immigration, trade, and direct investment. Country-level characteristics associated with globally integrated labor markets drive the integration between human and financial capital. For example, the positive association of inward FDI with implied correlation estimates suggests that when foreign firms generate wages, human capital returns are more highly correlated with foreign financial returns.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了1985-2020年"大缓和"时期人力资本风险的变化，发现虽然宏观经济稳定，但人力资本回报风险增加。作者通过国际投资组合数据、金融回报数据和投资组合选择模型，估算了人力资本与金融资本回报之间的隐含相关性，发现这种相关性因国家、时间而异，并与教育、移民、贸易和直接投资等因素相关。
AI.research_question: 在"大缓和"时期（1985-2020年），人力资本与金融资本回报之间的相关性如何变化？哪些因素驱动了这种相关性？
AI.motivation: 尽管"大缓和"时期宏观经济相对稳定，但人力资本风险却在增加（收入波动性上升、劳动力市场风险增加、全球化带来的风险暴露）。然而，测量人力资本风险和回报面临独特挑战，需要新的方法来理解人力资本与金融资本之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合选择理论，将人力资本视为一种资产，研究其与金融资本的相关性。运用国际金融和劳动力市场整合的理论框架，分析全球化对人力资本风险的影响。
AI.method: 使用国际投资组合持有数据、金融回报数据和投资组合选择模型，估算人力资本与金融资本回报之间的隐含相关性。分析跨国家和时间的变化，并检验与教育、移民、贸易和直接投资等因素的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 人力资本与金融资本回报的隐含相关性因国家和时间而异；2. 这种相关性与教育、移民、贸易和直接投资等因素相关；3. 全球劳动力市场整合程度高的国家特征驱动了人力资本与金融资本的整合；4. 外商直接投资与隐含相关性呈正相关，表明外国公司创造工资时，人力资本回报与外国金融回报相关性更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了测量人力资本风险的新方法；2. 建立了人力资本与金融资本整合的理论框架；3. 揭示了全球化背景下人力资本风险的变化机制；4. 扩展了投资组合理论在人力资本研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了理解人力资本风险的新视角；2. 帮助企业评估全球化对员工人力资本风险的影响；3. 为投资者提供了人力资本与金融资产相关性的实证证据；4. 为个人职业规划和风险管理提供参考。

title: Adults’ perceptions of rising food prices and its impact on food purchasing: findings from the 2022 International Food Policy Study
affiliations: , University of Waterloo, , Deakin University - Institute for Health Transformation, Deakin University - Faculty of Health, University of Waterloo, University of Waterloo,  and Université Laval

detail.title: Adults’ perceptions of rising food prices and its impact on food purchasing: findings from the 2022 International Food Policy Study
detail.abstract: Rising food prices reached record levels in 2022, raising global concern. This study examined consumer perceptions of food price increases in 2022 and their perceived effects on food purchasing in five countries, as well as differences by socio-demographic characteristics and household food security status. Data from 20,240 adults in the International Food Policy Study (2022), a cross-sectional online survey among adults from Australia, Canada, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and the United States, were analyzed. Respondents reported whether food had become more expensive for them in the last year and whether they altered ten food purchasing strategies and purchasing of three core and four non-core food categories in response to higher food prices. Regression models assessed differences by country, socio-demographic characteristics and household food security status. Across all countries, 78% to 85% of respondents perceived an increase in food prices in 2022. In response to higher food prices, the most commonly reported food purchasing strategy was switching to cheaper brands (43% to 34%). Despite some cross-country differences, respondents in all countries reported reductions in purchasing of non-core foods, such as desserts and non-alcoholic beverages, but also reductions in purchasing of core foods such as fruits and vegetables. In all countries, greater reported reductions in core food purchases were associated with lower perceived income adequacy and household food insecurity. Most respondents perceived food as less affordable in 2022 and reported diverse shifts in food purchasing as a result, with responses carrying possible implications for diet quality, food security and national policy responses.

AI.tldr: 2022年全球食品价格上涨引发关注，研究调查五个国家消费者对食品价格上涨的感知及其对食品购买行为的影响，发现78-85%消费者感知价格上涨，主要应对策略是转向更便宜品牌，核心和非核心食品购买均减少，低收入和食品不安全家庭受影响更大。
AI.research_question: 2022年五个国家消费者如何感知食品价格上涨？这些感知如何影响他们的食品购买策略和食品类别选择？不同社会经济特征和家庭食品安全状况的消费者有何差异？
AI.motivation: 2022年全球食品价格创历史新高引发广泛关注，需要了解消费者如何应对价格上涨，以及这对饮食质量、食品安全和国家政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和食品选择模型，研究消费者在价格压力下的应对策略，包括替代效应、预算约束和食品分类（核心vs非核心食品）。
AI.method: 使用国际食品政策研究（2022）的横断面在线调查数据，分析澳大利亚、加拿大、墨西哥、英国和美国20,240名成年人的回答。采用回归模型分析国家、社会经济特征和家庭食品安全状况的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 78-85%消费者感知2022年食品价格上涨；2. 最常见应对策略是转向更便宜品牌（43-34%）；3. 所有国家消费者都减少了非核心食品（甜点、非酒精饮料）和核心食品（水果蔬菜）的购买；4. 核心食品购买减少与低收入感知和家庭食品不安全显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了价格冲击下消费者食品选择行为的理论理解，揭示了核心食品和非核心食品购买同时减少的现象，挑战了传统食品替代理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，显示食品价格上涨对饮食质量的潜在负面影响，特别是对低收入和食品不安全家庭的更大冲击，支持针对性政策干预。

title: Unintended Consequences of Japan’s Eco-Car Policies Strategic Weight Manipulation and CO2 Emissions
affiliations: Kobe University, Nagoya University, Kobe University and Osaka University of Economics

detail.title: Unintended Consequences of Japan’s Eco-Car Policies Strategic Weight Manipulation and CO2 Emissions
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the environmental effectiveness of Japan’s eco-car tax incentive program by explicitly accounting for the strategic weight manipulation by automobile manufacturers. Using monthly vehicle-level panel data from 2005 to 2021, we estimate a structural demand model for the Japanese passenger car market to examine how firms respond to weight-based fuel economy standards.Our results show that vehicles strategically adjusted to exceed regulatory weight thresholds experienced a 31% increase in relative market share, reflecting a substantial demand expansion driven by regulatory compliance rather than genuine fuel efficiency improvements. To assess the broader implications, we conduct a structural substitution counterfactual analysis comparing the observed outcomes with a no-manipulation benchmark.The counterfactual analysis reveals that strategic weight manipulation increases the sales of manipulated vehicles by 102,771 units and reduces the sales of compliant vehicles by only 3,707 units. This asymmetric displacement indicates that manipulation primarily expands overall demand rather than reallocating sales among substitutes. The resulting demand distortion produced a net increase of 133,162 tons of CO2 emissions over the sample period, substantially undermining the policy’s emissions-reduction objectives.Our findings demonstrate that weight-class-based fuel economy regulation creates strong incentives for regulatory gaming, which materially weakens environmental effectiveness. The results highlight the need for policy designs that minimize discrete eligibility thresholds and reward continuous and verifiable improvements in real-world fuel efficiency.

AI.tldr: 日本生态汽车税收激励政策因车企战略操纵车辆重量而环境效果不佳。研究发现车企通过调整车辆重量超过监管阈值，使相关车辆市场份额增加31%，但这并非真正能效提升，而是监管套利。反事实分析显示这种操纵导致额外13.3万吨CO2排放，削弱了政策减排目标。
AI.research_question: 日本基于重量的燃油经济性监管政策如何激励汽车制造商进行战略重量操纵？这种操纵行为对政策的环境有效性产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 日本实施基于车辆重量的燃油经济性标准和生态汽车税收激励政策，旨在减少汽车排放。然而，政策设计中存在离散的监管阈值，可能激励车企通过操纵车辆重量来满足监管要求而非真正提升燃油效率，从而削弱政策的环境有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、企业战略行为理论、环境政策有效性理论、离散阈值激励理论
AI.method: 使用2005-2021年月度车辆层面面板数据，构建日本乘用车市场的结构需求模型，分析企业对基于重量的燃油经济性标准的反应。通过反事实分析比较实际结果与无操纵基准情景。
AI.findings: 1) 战略调整重量超过监管阈值的车辆相对市场份额增加31%；2) 重量操纵使被操纵车辆销量增加102,771辆，合规车辆仅减少3,707辆；3) 操纵主要扩大总需求而非在替代品间重新分配销量；4) 由此产生的需求扭曲导致样本期间净增加133,162吨CO2排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 实证验证了离散监管阈值如何激励企业战略操纵行为；2) 揭示了监管套利对政策环境有效性的实质性削弱机制；3) 提供了企业应对环境监管的战略行为经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了避免监管套利的设计建议：减少离散资格阈值，奖励连续且可验证的真实世界燃油效率改进；2) 揭示了日本生态汽车税收激励政策的环境效果局限性；3) 为其他国家类似政策设计提供警示和参考。

title: Cross-Border Sustainable Investing and Cost of Capital: Evidence from China’s Bond Market Liberalization

detail.title: Cross-Border Sustainable Investing and Cost of Capital: Evidence from China’s Bond Market Liberalization

keywords: Chinese bond markets JEL Classification Codes: C23

detail.abstract: We examine how cross-border capital transmit sustainability preferences to emerging bond markets. Exploiting China’s 2019 bond market liberalization as a natural experiment, we employ a triple-difference design with matched onshore-offshore bonds from identical issuers. Foreign investor entry reduces high-ESG firms’ borrowing costs by 9.6 basis points (8.8% of average spreads), despite representing only 1% of market capitalization. We show this large price impact is consistent with inelastic domestic demand amplifying small foreign flows. External validity tests based on proprietary data across 69 emerging markets confirm widespread transmission, highlighting financial globalization’s role in sustainable investing.

AI.tldr: 外国投资者通过跨境资本流动将可持续发展偏好传导至新兴债券市场，中国2019年债券市场开放政策显示，外资进入使高ESG企业的融资成本显著降低，尽管外资占比很小但价格影响显著
AI.research_question: 跨境资本如何将可持续发展偏好传导至新兴债券市场？
AI.motivation: 研究金融全球化背景下，外国投资者的ESG偏好如何影响新兴市场企业的融资成本，特别是当外资占比较小时是否仍能产生显著影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融全球化理论、资本流动理论、ESG投资理论、市场微观结构理论（非弹性需求放大效应）
AI.method: 三重差分设计，利用中国2019年债券市场自由化作为自然实验，匹配同一发行人的境内和境外债券数据
AI.findings: 外国投资者进入使高ESG企业的借款成本降低9.6个基点（占平均利差的8.8%），尽管外资仅占市值的1%；这种显著的价格影响源于国内需求非弹性放大了小规模外资流动；基于69个新兴市场的专有数据验证了传导效应的普遍性
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融全球化在可持续投资中的作用机制，证明了小规模外资流动通过非弹性需求放大效应产生显著价格影响，为跨境资本流动与ESG偏好传导提供了理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场政策制定者提供了债券市场开放对ESG融资影响的实证证据，为投资者理解跨境资本流动对可持续投资的影响提供参考，为企业利用ESG优势降低融资成本提供策略建议

title: Examining the Impact of Organizational Commitment on Decision-Making Styles under Hybrid Working Condition

detail.title: Examining the Impact of Organizational Commitment on Decision-Making Styles under Hybrid Working Condition
detail.abstract: PurposeHybrid work arrangements have become increasingly prevalent following the COVID-19 pandemic. Organizational commitment – conceptualized as moral, calculative, and alienative attachment to the organization– is likely to influence how employees make decisions. We examine how these commitment dimensions relate to five decision making styles (rational, intuitive, self-esteem-based, descriptive, and normative) under hybrid conditions. Understanding this relationship is important for designing effective management practices in modern, flexible work settings.DesignA quantitative survey was administered to 273 employees working under hybrid arrangements. Organizational commitment was measured using Penley and Gould’s (1988) 15-item scale covering moral, calculative, and alienative commitment. Decision making styles were assessed using Güler et al.’s (2021) 37-item behavioral decision scale, which includes the rational, intuitive, self-esteem, descriptive, and normative dimensions. Structural equation modeling (SEM) was employed to test the hypothesized relationships among commitment dimensions and decision styles.FindingsCalculative commitment positively and significantly influenced all five decision making styles. In contrast, higher alienative commitment (reflecting feelings of entrapment) was associated with lower use of self-esteem-based, descriptive, and normative decision styles. Moral commitment showed significant negative relationships with rational, intuitive, self-esteem-based, and descriptive styles, with no significant effect on the normative style.ConclusionsThese findings have implications for hybrid work management. Fostering calculative commitment – based on clear exchanges – can support structured and confident decision making, whereas high alienative commitment may undermine engagement and decisiveness. The complex pattern for moral commitment implies that values-driven employees may prefer consensus-driven decision processes. Managers should encourage open, inclusive decision processes to harness commitment constructively in hybrid teams. These insights can guide organizations in promoting the most adaptive commitment profiles and mitigating negative effects in evolving hybrid work environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨混合工作环境下组织承诺（道德、计算、疏离）如何影响员工决策风格（理性、直觉、自尊、描述、规范）。研究发现计算承诺对所有决策风格有积极影响，疏离承诺对部分决策风格有负面影响，道德承诺则与多数决策风格呈负相关。
AI.research_question: 在混合工作环境下，组织承诺的三个维度（道德承诺、计算承诺、疏离承诺）如何影响员工的五种决策风格（理性、直觉、自尊基础、描述性、规范性）？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情后混合工作安排日益普遍，组织承诺可能影响员工决策方式。理解这种关系对于在现代灵活工作环境中设计有效管理实践至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Penley和Gould（1988）的组织承诺三维度理论（道德、计算、疏离承诺），以及Güler等人（2021）的决策风格五维度模型（理性、直觉、自尊、描述、规范）。
AI.method: 采用定量调查方法，对273名混合工作员工进行问卷调查。使用Penley和Gould的15项组织承诺量表测量三个承诺维度，使用Güler等人的37项行为决策量表测量五种决策风格。采用结构方程模型（SEM）检验假设关系。
AI.findings:
1. 计算承诺对所有五种决策风格都有显著正向影响
2. 疏离承诺（反映被困感）与自尊基础、描述性和规范性决策风格呈负相关
3. 道德承诺与理性、直觉、自尊基础和描述性决策风格呈显著负相关，对规范性风格无显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了组织承诺理论在混合工作环境中的应用，揭示了不同承诺维度对决策风格的具体影响机制，为理解现代工作环境中的员工决策行为提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为混合工作管理提供实践指导：培养基于明确交换的计算承诺可以支持结构化决策，高疏离承诺可能削弱决策参与度，道德承诺高的员工可能偏好共识驱动的决策过程。管理者应鼓励开放包容的决策过程，构建适应性承诺模式。
